title: Nicer Old Netherrack
description: Resprite of the original netherrack texture that keeps the original feel while looking less ugly.
body:
This resource pack only resprites the following five blocks with the goal of keeping the feel of the original netherrack texture while also making it look prettier:
- Netherrack
- Crimson Nylium
- Warped Nylium
- Nether Gold Ore
- Nether Quartz Ore
